turns.query: How many distinct 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION' sensitive areas have their polygon centroid within 5000 metres of at least one roadside air-quality station (station_id 14, 16, or 17)? The three stations are close together and their catchments overlap heavily; count each institution only once. Return the count.
code_snippets:
from sqlalchemy import text

# First, verify the station types for IDs 14, 16, 17
verify_query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, station_type
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id IN (14, 16, 17)
""")
verify_df = pd.read_sql(verify_query, engine)
print("Roadside stations verification:")
print(verify_df)

# Count distinct EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION sensitive areas within 5000m of any of the three roadside stations
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) as count
FROM sensitive_area sa
WHERE sa.category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM air_quality_station aqs
    WHERE aqs.id IN (14, 16, 17)
    AND ST_Distance(
        sa.geometry::geography,
        ST_Centroid(aqs.coordinate::geography)
    ) <= 5000
)
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"\nCount of distinct EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION within 5000m of roadside stations 14, 16, 17: {result['count'].values[0]}")

schools_roadside_5km = int(result['count'].values[0])
